component.name: Bandito
component.summary: Network bandwidth monitor and traffic shaper

description.p: Bandito shows how much each application downloads and uploads, and lets you limit any of them, or all of them at once, over IPv4 and IPv6. It measures and limits with netleash, which uses eBPF.

ul.li: Live rates and a short history for every application
Download and upload limits per application, remembered across restarts
The hosts and services each application is talking to
Switch between networks from the header bar

screenshot.caption: Traffic per application, with limits on two of them
Limiting an application and seeing its connections
Traffic that couldn't be matched to a program, in dark mode

description.p: Bandito is packaged as .rpm and .deb, with its menu entry and icon.

ul.li: The packages include netleash, so Bandito doesn't download it
With them, administrators at the machine aren't asked for a password, as with NetworkManager; other users enter an administrator's password
The menu entry is named Bandito

description.p: Bandito tells you when a newer version is out.

ul.li: On start, it asks GitHub for its releases and shows a banner with a Download button when one is newer
"Check for updates" in the main menu turns it off

description.p: Bandito shows each app's traffic by process, with netleash 0.3.0.

ul.li: When several processes in an app use the network, each gets a line under the app
The app's panel lists its processes, and marks the ones that exited

description.p: Bandito starts a little faster, with jsGTK 0.75.
A Bandito binary for 64-bit ARM (aarch64) is released alongside the x86_64 one.
Bandito measures and limits traffic on 64-bit ARM (aarch64) too.
Bandito now measures and limits traffic with netleash, one eBPF helper.

ul.li: IPv6 traffic is limited too
Upload limits are paced instead of dropping packets
Apps are named by their application ID, so names and icons match
Less traffic shows up as unidentified
A shorter password prompt, or none when netleash has its capabilities

description.p: The window responds right away to new traffic and wakes the CPU less while idle, with jsGTK 0.72.
The helper programs Bandito downloads are pinned to exact versions and checked before they run as root.
A redesign of the whole application.

ul.li: A summary of total traffic with a one-minute chart
Applications sorted by activity, with real names, icons and a 30-second history
A side panel for limits with presets, units and undo
Limits are remembered and applied again on start
Each application's connections, with hosts and services
A new icon
